sections.h2: What Is DevOps, and Why Does It Matter?

paragraphs.text: DevOps is the practice of automating how software is built, tested, released and run. Instead of developers copying files to a server by hand, every change passes through automated checks and is deployed the same way every time. Problems are caught earlier, releases become routine, and systems recover faster when something fails.
For a growing business, good DevOps services Kochi teams can rely on mean fewer late-night emergencies, faster feature releases and predictable cloud bills.

What is CI/CD? CI stands for continuous integration: every code change is automatically built and tested as soon as it is pushed. CD stands for continuous delivery or deployment: changes that pass the tests are released to staging or live servers automatically, often several times a day.

Our CI/CD pipeline setup uses tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps. Each pipeline runs tests, security checks and builds, then deploys with a clear approval step for live releases and a one-click rollback if something goes wrong.

sections.h2: What DevOps and Cloud Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: AWS Deployment Services
items.text: Our AWS deployment services cover servers, managed databases, storage, load balancers, content delivery and security groups on Amazon Web Services. We design for your real traffic and budget, not for the largest possible setup.

items.title: Azure Cloud Services
items.text: Azure cloud services suit organisations already using Microsoft 365, Active Directory or .NET applications. We set up app services, databases, networking and identity on Microsoft Azure, with access controls matched to your team.

items.title: Google Cloud Deployment
items.text: Google Cloud deployment suits data-heavy and container-based applications. We use managed services wherever possible, so there are fewer servers for your team to look after.

items.title: Docker Containerization Services
items.text: Docker containerization services package each application with everything it needs to run, so it behaves the same on a developer laptop, a test server and production. In the 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, about 71% of developers reported using Docker, making it a standard part of modern deployment.

items.title: Kubernetes Setup and Management
items.text: Kubernetes setup and management suits larger systems with many services that need automatic scaling and self-healing. We recommend Kubernetes only where it pays off, because simpler container platforms are often cheaper and easier to run.

items.title: Infrastructure as Code With Terraform
items.text: Infrastructure as code with Terraform describes your entire cloud setup in version-controlled files. Environments can be recreated in minutes, every change is reviewed like code, and nothing depends on one person remembering how a server was configured.

items.title: Cloud Server Monitoring
items.text: Cloud server monitoring tracks uptime, response times, errors, disk space and unusual activity around the clock. Alerts reach the right person by email, SMS or chat, so issues are fixed before most users notice.

items.title: Automated Backups and Disaster Recovery
items.text: Automated backups and disaster recovery protect your databases and files with scheduled, encrypted backups stored in a separate location. We test restores regularly and document exactly how to recover, with agreed recovery time targets.

items.title: DevSecOps Practices
items.text: DevSecOps practices build security into every step: dependency scanning, secret management, least-privilege access, encrypted traffic, regular patching and audit logs. Security becomes part of the daily pipeline rather than a yearly check.

paragraphs.text: Cloud cost optimization reviews what you pay for and what you actually use. Common savings come from right-sizing oversized servers, switching off idle test environments at night, using reserved or committed pricing for steady workloads, and cleaning up forgotten storage. Every recommendation comes with an estimated monthly saving before any change is made.

Typical work from our DevOps services Kochi team includes moving manual deployments to automated pipelines, containerising older applications, setting up staging environments that mirror production, adding monitoring after an outage, and cutting cloud bills that grew faster than the business.

sections.h2: AWS vs Azure for Small Businesses

paragraphs.text: AWS vs Azure for small businesses usually comes down to existing tools. AWS offers the widest range of services and a large community, which suits most web applications and startups. Azure fits best when a business already relies on Microsoft 365, Windows servers or .NET software, because identity and billing integrate neatly. Google Cloud is a strong option for data-heavy and container-based workloads. We recommend one in writing after the audit.

sections.h2: How Much Do DevOps Services Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much do DevOps services cost in India? It depends on the number of applications and environments, the cloud platform, security requirements and whether you need one-time setup or ongoing support. Cloud provider charges are billed separately by AWS, Azure or Google.
Every engagement is quoted after the audit, and the quote is fixed for the agreed scope. Quotes for our DevOps services Kochi clients list exactly what is included, from pipelines to monitoring.

items.q: Do we need DevOps if we are a small team?
items.a: Yes, at a basic level. Even a two-person team benefits from automated deployments, backups and monitoring. We scale the setup to your size, so you avoid both manual risk and unnecessary complexity.

items.q: Will moving to CI/CD cause downtime?
items.a: No. Pipelines are built and tested alongside your current process, and switched on only when they are proven. Live releases then become safer than manual ones.

items.q: What do DevOps services Kochi clients receive each month?
items.a: Monthly support includes uptime and error monitoring, security patching, backup checks, a short report on incidents and costs, and a set number of hours for improvements. Urgent issues are handled first, whatever the plan size. These DevOps services Kochi clients choose can be adjusted as your systems grow.

items.q: Do we own the cloud accounts and configuration?
items.a: Yes. Cloud accounts stay in your name, and all infrastructure code, pipelines and documentation are handed over to you.
